score.doctor_final_text:
I understand how frightening this is, but I have identified what is causing your body to react this way to your medication. Your symptoms, combined with the haloperidol use and high muscle enzyme levels, indicate you are experiencing Neuroleptic Malignant Syndrome. We are going to stop the medication and begin intensive treatment to cool you down and relax your muscles immediately.

DIAGNOSIS READY: Neuroleptic Malignant Syndrome

dialogue.text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent, and I'll be looking after you today. Can you tell me if you have been experiencing a headache, a stiff neck, or any sensitivity to light along with your fever?
No, I haven't really had a headache or any trouble with the light. My whole body just feels incredibly stiff and heavy, like my muscles won't relax.
That sounds very uncomfortable. Have you recently started any new medications or changed the dosage of any medicines you take for your mood or mental health?
I haven't changed anything myself, but I take haloperidol for my tics. I've been sweating so much lately too, and I feel really confused about how I got here.

I understand. Have you or anyone around you noticed your heart racing or your blood pressure being very high or low lately?
